Harper Archers are summonable, failsafe allies that provide ranged support in Act Three.
“
We fight for the fate of the city.
„
— Harper Archer's battle cry

Involvement

Act Three

Harper Archers can be summoned with the  Gather Your Allies variant,  Silver Harp Squadron, provided  Jaheira is an ally and all previous incarnations of the Harpers are dead.

Notes

  • Some members of this archetype may have slightly different passives, movement speed, weight, and size due to being members of different races.
  • The Harper Archers wear a set of armour identical in apperance to the  Ring Mail Armour +2 and  Leather Helmet dyed in Harper colours, but are actually equipped with the default  Ring Mail Armour.
  • The only way to summon Harper Archers are if  Naysa,  Lymn and  Antony die in Last Light Inn, and their replacement  Grenywald,  Lanni and  Olys die in the Assault on Moonrise Towers.
  • These Harper Archers are stronger than all previous incarnations of the Harper summon, as Naysa, Lymn, and Antony lack the ability to use their Extra Attack feature, and Grenywald, Lanni, and Olys are only level 6.
